statement.en: Drawers in turn revising toward best responses, from any profile, both leave nothing at every step from round 2N on: they come to the perfect profile within twice the horizon, mutual restraint included.
statement.zh: 轮流的抽取者向最优回应修订，自任一组合出发，自第 2N 轮起两者每步不留：在视野的两倍之内达到完美组合，相互克制亦然。

laws.en: A profile revises another where each new rule, at every step from every level, is a best response to the old profile; the first of finitely many amounts drawing the most always gives one, so revisions exist from any profile.
laws.zh: 一个组合修订另一个，若每条新规则在每步、从每个水平都是对旧组合的最优回应；有限多个量中抽取最多的第一个总给出一个，故修订自任一组合都存在。

laws.en: Along every sequence of revisions over N steps, from any profile, both leave nothing at every step of the last k from round 2 k on; so from round 2 N on the profile draws everything and the base stands from the first step at what stands at nothing.
laws.zh: 沿 N 步上的每个修订序列，自任一组合出发，自第 2 k 轮起两者在最后 k 步每步不留；故自第 2 N 轮起组合全部抽取，自第一步起基础立于零处所立者。

laws.en: On a web, from round 2 N on, a dependence above what stands at nothing, met at the start, is broken at the first step.
laws.zh: 在网上，自第 2 N 轮起，起始时被满足、高于零处所立者的依存在第一步被打破。

laws.en: Witness: under the gate, two drawers who both start by leaving everything keep the dweller; revised from round 2 (n + 2) on they break it.
laws.zh: 见证：门控下，两个开始都留下一切的抽取者保持居者；自第 2 (n + 2) 轮起修订后它们打破它。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. SG14's model: any law G of what stands; two drawers in turn, no capacity limit; plain sums over the steps that remain; rules reading the step and the level; revision simultaneous, each new rule a best response against the old profile at every step from every level; natural amounts, discrete steps.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。SG14 的模型：任一所立之律 G；两个轮流的抽取者，无容量限制；其后各步之和；规则读取步与水平；修订同时进行，每条新规则在每步、从每个水平都是对旧组合的最优回应；自然数量，离散步。

does_not_show.en: Revision that is not a best response: noisy, partial or local learning.
does_not_show.zh: 非最优回应的修订：有噪声、部分或局部的学习。

does_not_show.en: Drawers whose capacities limit a draw, more than two, or drawing at once.
does_not_show.zh: 受容量限制、多于两个或同时抽取的抽取者。

does_not_show.en: That the bound 2N is tight in general: it is the induction's.
does_not_show.zh: 界 2N 一般是紧的：它是归纳给出的界。

next_delta.en: Noisy or partial revision; capacities limiting a draw; more drawers; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 有噪声或部分的修订；容量限制抽取；更多抽取者；独立审查。

correspondence.en: Best-response dynamics settles on the backward-induction outcome in finite games of perfect information (Fudenberg and Levine 1998); cooperation unravels from the last period (Selten 1978).
correspondence.zh: 在有限完美信息博弈中，最优回应动态落在逆向归纳的结果上（Fudenberg 与 Levine 1998）；合作自最后一期瓦解（Selten 1978）。
